lines.text: The congregation of Israel stayed in Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin, and there Miriam died and was buried.
With no water, the people quarreled with Moses and asked why he had led them out of Moab.
Moses and Aaron fell facedown at the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of the LORD appeared to them.
The LORD told Moses to pour oil on the rock, but Moses struck it twice and water gushed out.
The LORD said Moses and Aaron would not bring the assembly into the land, because they did not trust Him.
